scope: Offline provided-fact parser and admitted RPC adapter unit tests; synthetic ProgramData/review/financial status, no chain release acceptance

captured exact USDC sell builds category 6 with 57 bytes and 41 canonical metas

market owner, pool orientation, coin-creator and special-mode changes are rejected
fee recipient membership and canonical WSOL custody are required

wrong genesis, loader, authority and full ProgramData context cannot authenticate proof
missing or nonfinalized signature status and slot mismatch remain unresolved
missing or stale finalized account evidence and RPC errors cannot finalize
signature, frozen message and failed transaction substitution are rejected
invalid operator or independent price signature cannot authenticate the transaction
